slides.h1: Mercury Hora for Calls, Saturn Hora for the Grind
slides.sub: A practical weekly template using planetary hours.

slides.body: Hora means planetary hour. Each day is split into hours ruled in turn by a planet, counted from local sunrise. Check a panchang for your city's exact timings.
Mercury (planet of communication and trade) hours suit negotiation calls, emails, contracts and anything that needs clear words.
Saturn (planet of discipline) hours suit slow, unglamorous work: backlog, accounts, documentation, the task you keep postponing.

points: Pick one Mercury Hora for key calls
Pick one Saturn Hora for deep work
Keep both slots fixed all week

slides.body: Try the free Hora Planner and see your best slots for calls and focused work.
